#### List:

- Exponential function
- Natural exponential function
- Exponential decay

#### Exponential function:

+----------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Equation | - y = a^x^                                                                                                                   |
|          | - Output equals a constant to the power of the input                                                                         |
+----------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Graph    | Runaway curve                                                                                                                |
|          |                                                                                                                              |
|          | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2012/B/13/prize-image001.jpg){fig-alt="Number of bacteria against time showing exponential growth"} |
+----------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Natural exponential function:

+----------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Equation | - y=Ae^x^ = δy/δx (where e = 2.718281828…)                                                                                         |
|          | - i.e. rate of change of Y is proportional to amount of Y                                                                          |
+----------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Graphs   | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2012/B/13/prize-image002.jpg){fig-alt="Natural exponential curve through zero–one and one–e coordinates"} |
+----------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Use      | Used to model time-dependent exponential processes                                                                                 |
|          |                                                                                                                                    |
|          | - Drug metabolism                                                                                                                  |
|          | - Alveolar filling                                                                                                                 |
|          | - Pre-oxygenation                                                                                                                  |
|          | - Radioactive decay                                                                                                                |
+----------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Exponential decay:

+--------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Equation           | N = N~0~e^-kt^                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                    |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|                    | Where                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|                    |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|                    | - N = amount of isotope                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|                    | - N~0~ = amount of isotope at t=0                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
+--------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Graph              | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2012/B/13/prize-image003.jpg){fig-alt="Isotope amount against time showing exponential decay"}      ![](/content/exams/anzca/2012/B/13/prize-image004.jpg){fig-alt="Log isotope amount against time showing linear decay"} |
+--------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Rate constant (k)  | - Proportion of isotopes decaying per unit time, had the initial rate of decay continued                                                                                                                                                            |
|                    |   - Units: min^-1^                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
+--------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Time constant (τ)  | - Time taken for completion had the initial rate of decay continued                                                                                                                                                                                 |
|                    | - τ = 1/k                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|                    | - Units: minutes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                    | - \~95% completion at 3 x τ                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
+--------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Half life (t~1/2~) | - Time taken for 50% decay                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
|                    | - t~1/2~ = τ x log~e~2                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                    | - \~97% completion =  5 x t~1/2~                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
+--------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
